about: Ledger of the attack corpus identifiers (test/audit-corpus.js, ADR-0087). Append-only: a new case takes the next number; a removed case moves to `retired` with the date and the reason, and its number is never given again. Each identifier is pinned to its case name, so a renumbering shows up as a changed line here. Guarded by test/unit/audit-corpus-ids.test.js.

assigned.AC-001: self-citation: the manifest is its own evidence
assigned.AC-002: self-citation: a rule's own file proves the rule
assigned.AC-003: self-citation: the same target, five characters shorter
assigned.AC-004: fabricated corpus: 36 files containing the word ok
assigned.AC-005: deleted lock: the corpus is fabricated AND the lock removed
assigned.AC-006: forged lock: the corpus is fabricated AND the lock re-signed
assigned.AC-007: re-signed downgrade: a shipped rule kept under its name, made harmless, and its lock line re-signed
assigned.AC-008: deviation resting on the scaffolded template
assigned.AC-009: deviation resting on a zero-byte ADR
assigned.AC-010: symlink escape: evidence outside the repository
assigned.AC-013: a CRLF checkout is not a gutted corpus
assigned.AC-014: a house rule that cannot satisfy the floor is welcome
assigned.AC-015: a documentary rule may cite the section that states the fact
